answer: Built C:\proveit_work\T22\T22.aprx (own geodatabase C:\proveit_work\T22\T22.gdb) by saveACopy of the Desktop PlatterOfPython.aprx (read only), stripped to three maps plus the ProveIt.pyt toolbox as default toolbox. Map 1 shows ZIP areas shaded by observed FDNY travel minus modeled drive time (scored areas only) with firehouses; map 2 shows Ida high-water marks and control points by role; map 3 shows 45,433 structures by inspection outcome. Reopened: 3 maps, no broken layers, toolbox attached, maps recorded as open tabs. Not visually checked in the Pro window, and the original project was not touched.
traps_or_caveats: Wildfire: 14,993 structures have no damage record; shown in gray as 'no inspection record', not as undamaged. 41 Inaccessible shown separately.
Fire: 11 of 178 ZIP areas are not scored (10 with <20 incidents, 1 with no observation). gap_min is null there, and they are labelled as not scored. Observed is travel time, not total response time.

Fire model is drive time at the posted speed limit from the nearest firehouse and has a median bias of about 2.2 min against observed travel times. The map shows the gap, not a validated coverage estimate.

Ida: 31 interior marks are flagged separately, because their depth is not comparable with street marks. Control points are random stand-ins, not known dry locations. 7 marks have no depth. The DEM ignores sewers.
Wildfire layer covers only structures inside the fire perimeters, so it describes loss among reached structures, not fire spread. Wind, embers, vegetation and hardening are not in the data.
Basemap (Light Gray Canvas) needs a portal connection. The toolbox path points to the Mac share (\\Mac\Home\...\pro\ProveIt.pyt), so it only resolves while the share is mounted.
I did not open the project in the Pro GUI. Verification was via ArcPy: map and layer names, feature counts, isBroken, renderer types.
